Lower half is a broad quiet shadowed arch or chamber with low contrast and no new action, people, bright props or body piles. Keep the ritual understandable at70x100 pixels. All human, dead and depicted faces are completely INDISCERNIBLE at full resolution: rear views, completely sealed helmets or opaque hood voids; no eyes, noses, mouths or portrait features. Corpses completely shrouded, no detailed skull faces or exposed wounds. Non-graphic adult ritual sacrifice may be implied by a sealed machine or an empty dark passage, never shown as injury. This is a functioning remnant institution transformed into the body of its own inhuman patron The Unbending Crown. Its alien presence comes from impossible anatomy-like architecture, chitinous stone folds, oppressive scale and ritual geometry, not generic piles of tentacles.
